title: openmilk backup
description: Backup / import file format for openmilk, the browser-resident task manager. Agents can generate this file to import tasks (import merges idempotently: for the same id, the record with the newer updatedAt wins) or read it to list the user's tasks. Version history: 1-3 legacy, 4 adds Task.parentId (subtasks).

schemaVersion.description: Backup format version. Use 4 for new files.

task.description: A task. Delete is logical (deleted: 1) — never physically remove a task from a backup you merge.

remindMinutesBefore.description: Reminder: minutes before the due moment.

trackedMinutes.description: Confirmed actual effort in minutes (time tracked so far).

timerStartedAt.description: ISO 8601. Present only while the task is being tracked (one task at a time).

listId.description: Owning list id. Omit for INBOX.

parentId.description: Parent task id (subtask). Subtasks are one level deep only.

completedAt.description: ISO 8601 completion time. Omit while the task is open.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 creation time. Required for merge ordering.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 last-update time. Bump on every change; merge keeps the newer record.

deleted.description: Logical delete flag: 1 means the task is in the trash.

list.description: A list (sidebar section). INBOX is implicit: tasks without listId live there.

order.description: Display order. The fixed GTD lists use negative values: next action -3, waiting -2, someday -1.

fixed.description: 1 for the non-deletable GTD lists (next action / waiting / someday).
